thread:
tyler.marketing: T-minus 72h — prepping announce for embeddings pricing + hosting improvements. Need final changelog entry, docs link, rollout timing, and webinar slot pinned. Can we get owners?

sam.engineering: I can own changelog and canary timing. planning a canary at Wed 10:00 PST (2026-03-25T18:00Z). Is that OK?

oli.docs: I'll take docs. Need final API param example + sample responses. Can someone paste the final schema?

jess.product: Webinar slot: Thurs 11am PT works for the customer-facing webinar. Marketing will need a short hero paragraph + 3 bullets by EOD tomorrow.

maya.salesops: I'll wire up inbound lead routing. Question: do we route webinar registrants to SDR queue or AE-led? Prefer SDR first.

sam.engineering: Canary timing confirmed. Plan: canary -> 30m soak -> rollout to 10% -> ramp if metrics ok. I'll post the canary job id when scheduled.

release-bot: Deploy job queued: `deploy-canary:rdw-embeddings-v2` — ETA Wed 10:00 PST. Job ID: 987654321.

tyler.marketing: Great. Oli, for docs we want a short snippet like: `POST /v1/embeddings` with JSON example. Keep it <120 words for the announcement.

oli.docs: Copy draft: "Embeddings API: faster, cheaper, and more consistent. POST /v1/embeddings — returns vector and metadata. See full docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/embeddings/2026" Thoughts?

jess.product: That reads well. Add a note on quantization/quality tradeoffs: "Default config optimized for production latency; see advanced quantization options in docs."

tyler.marketing: Love it. Sam — changelog entry? Keep it bulletized (one-liner).

sam.engineering: Changelog draft: "Embeddings: improved serving stack with prefix caching; 2x throughput and 40% cost reduction for medium-length inputs. Canary: rdw-embeddings-v2 (job 987654321)."

maya.salesops: Routing decision: webinar registrants -> SDR triage queue; high-intent (company size >1000 or >50 seats) -> AE drip. I'll attach routing rules to the doc.

tyler.marketing: Copy deck + tweet drafts due EOD. Quick asks: 1) Docs final URL (oli) 2) Changelog snippet (sam) 3) Canary job id (release-bot) 4) Webinar landing page (jess)

oli.docs: Docs URL is https://docs.redwood.ai/embeddings/2026 - final page pushed to staging.

release-bot: Canary job 987654321 started: logs -> https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/987654321/logs

sam.engineering: Logs look healthy so far. No errors in first 1000 requests. Metrics: p50 latency 34ms, error rate 0.02%.

jess.product: I'll build the webinar landing page and drop the link here once it's live. ETA 6pm PT today.

tyler.marketing: Draft hero copy for review: "Meet Embeddings v2 — faster vectors, lower cost. Join our webinar Thurs 11am PT to see benchmarks and migration tips." Bullets: "2x throughput, 40% cost savings, production-grade API + rollout plan."

oli.docs: Tiny tweak: change "Join our webinar" -> "Join our live webinar".

maya.salesops: Routing rules attached (shortlink): https://short.redwood.ai/emb-route — SDR queue + AE escalation rules.

sam.engineering: After 30m soak we'll start ramp to 10%. Setting alert at error rate >0.5% or p95 latency >200ms.

release-bot: Canary job 987654321 completed: status SUCCESS.

tyler.marketing: :party: Nice. Sam, can you confirm roll schedule now?

sam.engineering: Rolling out to 10% now. Will post update at each step.

jess.product: Webinar page live: https://events.redwood.ai/embeddings-v2 — registration link included.

tyler.marketing: OK team — final checklist before announce: docs URL (oli) ✅, changelog snippet (sam) ✅, webinar page (jess) ✅, routing (maya) ✅, tweet + blog draft (marketing) in progress. Party emoji when ready.

oli.docs: Docs pushed to prod: https://docs.redwood.ai/embeddings/2026 ✅

sam.engineering: Changelog entry pushed to repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/commit/abc123 ✅

maya.salesops: Routing live and tested with sample payloads. ✅

tyler.marketing: Final ask: sam + oli — please drop the direct URLs for changelog anchor and docs in the announce copy so we can finalize headers.

sam.engineering: Changelog anchor: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog#embeddings-v2 ✅

oli.docs: Docs anchor: https://docs.redwood.ai/embeddings/2026#overview ✅

tyler.marketing: Perfect. We'll schedule the public post for Wed 12:00 PST to let canary ramp. Webinar reminder email scheduled for Thurs 9am PT. Thanks all — will post final tweet thread here when live. :thumbsup:

release-bot: Rollout update: now at 30% traffic, metrics within thresholds.

sam.engineering: Rolling to 100% over next hour if metrics remain green.

tyler.marketing: Posting thread in 2 hours. Leave any last-minute copy notes here.

jess.product: All good from product.

maya.salesops: SDR playbook attached to the registration export.

oli.docs: Minor docs PR merged for code snippet formatting.

tyler.marketing: Going to draft the blog + tweet now. Will ping for final sign-off before publish.

sam.engineering: Confirming 100% rollout complete — all healthy.

release-bot: Deployment finished. All checks green.

tyler.marketing: Final sign-off received. Publishing at 12:00 PST. :eyes:
